knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Dosing above the label or outside the plan is not allowed. The correct response retests, follows the label and the plan, and refers any adjustment the plan does not cover.
Evaporation removes water and leaves the salt behind, so a fresh-water top-up keeps the salinity steady. Salt water would raise it.
The pump is isolated and proved off before the cup or housing is opened, so that the pump cannot restart while the cup is open.

practicalCriteria: Learner confirms the marine system type from a training plan and records it before any test is made
Learner tops up a training tank with fresh water where the plan says so, and explains the choice in one sentence
Learner refuses a dosing request that the training plan does not cover, and records the refusal and the referral
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: System type record confirmed from the plan
Top-up record with the water used and the reason
Refusal and referral record for the dosing request
Assessor observation of the isolation before the skimmer cup is opened
stopWorkCriteria: A request to add a product above the label dose or outside the plan
A skimmer cup or housing opened while its pump is running
Coral or animal treatment proposed by the learner
